panels.description:
Indicates the outcome of processing control plane policy related objects like CNP/CCNP. Source indicates the type of resource:
* directory: Local policy(CNP/CCNP)
* k8s: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy/ClusterNetworkPolicy
* custom-resource: CNP/CCNP
panels.title: Control plane policy processing rate

panels.description: Tracks time between a policy change and it being fully deployed into the datapath.
panels.title: Policy Implementation Latencies

panels.description:
Tracks endpoint policy related operation latencies during endpoint regeneration.
* waitForPolicyRepository: Time taken to get lock on policy repository for selector policy calculation.
* policyCalculation: Total time taken in regenerating endpoint policy.
* proxyConfiguration: Time taken to configure L7 proxy redirects.
* selectorPolicyCalculation: Time taken to generate selector policy from policy repository.
* endpointPolicyCalculation: Time taken to generate endpoint policy from selector policy.
* waitForPolicyCompute: Time endpoint regeneration thread waited for policy to be computed.
* proxyPolicyCalculation: Time taken by the L7 proxy shim to process the NetworkPolicy
* proxyWaitForAck: Additional time regeneration blocked on ACK from L7 proxy shim.
* mapSync: Time taken in BPF map updates(for all endpoint updates including policy).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(node, scope, le) (rate(cilium_endpoint_regeneration_time_stats_seconds_bucket{scope=~"policyCalculation|waitForPolicyRepository|selectorPolicyCalculation|endpointPolicyCalculation|proxyConfiguration|policyCalculation|waitForPolicyCompute|proxyWaitForAck|mapSync",status="success", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))
